name: Yuni (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Yuni town emblem in white: two angular shapes, a parallelogram above a pentagon, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yuni, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1968.

features.role: Yuni town emblem — two angular shapes, a parallelogram above a pentagon, forming a stylised character
